d: Addressing a press conference in Lucknow, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav targeted the BJP government on a range of issues, ranging from electoral roll deletions to national security. Proposing that Uttar Pradesh issue tamper-proof metal Aadhaar cards under a future Samajwadi government, Yadav alleged that fake voter IDs were being fabricated on polling days to delete legitimate PDA (Pichhde, Dalit, Alpasankhyak) votes. He slammed the government's rhetoric on "infiltrators," questioning why the ruling party remains silent on Chinese border encroachments while engaging in heavy trade…
